title: Open Mic Night @ The Slow Down Coffee Co.
event_description: Weekly open mic night in a welcoming community-focused environment. All skill levels encouraged to share stories music poetry and more or just enjoy the performances. A perfect intimate gathering for local artists and music lovers.
event_venue_information:
About The Slow Down Coffee Co.

The Slow Down Coffee Co. is a locally-owned specialty coffee shop in the historic Highland Park neighborhood on the northside of Des Moines. This welcoming space invites patrons to slow down sip slowly and live with intention.

Open Mic Night

Every Thursday evening The Slow Down transforms into an inclusive performance space for their Open Mic Night. The event welcomes performers of all skill levels to share music poetry storytelling and more. Whether performing or listening the atmosphere is warm and community-focused.

Location and Hours

Located at 3613 6th Ave the coffee shop is open Monday closed Tuesday-Friday 6:30am-8pm and weekends with reduced hours. The Highland Park location provides a neighborhood gathering spot with quality coffee and community events.

title: Manic Monday Open Mic @ Lefty's Live Music
event_description: Open mic night welcoming all performers - musicians comedians or anyone wanting stage time. A supportive environment to showcase talent jam with others or try something new. Every Monday night at this renowned Des Moines music venue.
event_venue_information:
About Lefty's Live Music

Lefty's Live Music is a 350-capacity concert hall and full-service bar in the Drake Neighborhood of Des Moines. Since opening in 2015 it has become the premier destination for live music in central Iowa welcoming all genres from rock and hip hop to bluegrass metal folk and blues.

Manic Monday Open Mic

Every Monday at 8pm Lefty's hosts an open mic night that encourages all types of performers. Whether you want to jam show off stand-up comedy or just take the stage the venue provides a full PA system and backline equipment. The supportive atmosphere makes it perfect for first-timers and veterans alike.

Venue Features

The venue features quality sound systems proper stage lighting and a full bar. With a capacity of 350 it strikes the perfect balance between intimate and energetic. Lefty's has hosted everything from national touring acts to local garage bands and maintains a strong commitment to uplifting the Des Moines music scene.

Music Scene Hub

Since 2015 Lefty's has been inspiring audiences and supporting musicians. The venue hosts live music up to 7 nights a week and serves as a cornerstone of Des Moines diverse and talented music culture. All ages shows run 5-9pm per city law while 21+ events continue later.

title: CJC Jazz Jam Session @ The Cave DSM
event_description: Monthly jazz jam session for middle school through high school students led by professional working jazz musicians. Students perform learn on-the-spot and experience jazz improvisation in a non-competitive supportive environment.
hosts: Community Jazz Center trio of working jazz musicians
event_venue_information:
About The Cave DSM & Jazz Sessions

The Cave DSM hosts the Community Jazz Center's monthly jam sessions providing a downtown venue for young musicians to develop their skills and passion for jazz.

CJC Jam Sessions

Since 1988 the Community Jazz Center has been hosting jam sessions exclusively for middle school to high school students. These sessions are led by a trio of working jazz musicians from the Des Moines community who provide real-time mentorship and accompaniment.

Learning Experience

Students meet young musicians from around central Iowa and many have formed combos and lifelong friendships through these sessions. They develop valuable skills including teamwork communication leadership and self-confidence while experiencing the thrill of jazz improvisation outside of school settings.

Performance Opportunities

Participating students may pursue playing opportunities with the CJC Youth Combo or the CJC Big Band. The sessions focus on learning and growth with professional rhythm section players and occasional special guests creating an invaluable educational experience.

title: Blues Tuesday Open Mic @ Carl's Place
event_description: Weekly blues-focused open mic night featuring live music from local musicians. Known for hosting one of the best house blues bands in Des Moines creating an authentic dive bar atmosphere perfect for blues lovers and musicians.
backline: Pool table dart boards and stage available
event_venue_information:
About Carl's Place

Carl's Place is a beloved neighborhood dive bar in the Sherman Hill area of Des Moines. This authentic dive bar has been serving the community for years offering a comfortable unpretentious atmosphere with long hours and reasonable prices.

Blues Tuesday & Open Mic

Every Tuesday Carl's Place hosts an open mic night that has become legendary in the local music scene. The event features live blues music and welcomes musicians to perform in a professionally-run environment. The venue is known for having one of the best house blues bands in the city.

Dive Bar Character

Carl's Place embodies classic dive bar charm with its pool table dart boards and small stage for live music. The extensive beer selection is listed on Untappd and the bartenders are known for their quick friendly service. The atmosphere is relaxed and welcoming making it a favorite among locals and travelers alike.

Community Hub

This Sherman Hill institution has become the neighborhood's version of Cheers where regulars and newcomers mix freely. The venue attracts a diverse eclectic crowd and maintains its authentic character. Open from 10am-2am daily Carl's Place offers a true Des Moines dive bar experience.
